name: [🚗] My Car Workshop!
desc:
🚗 Welcome to My Workshop!

👍 Like the game and join the group for 7,500 MONEY in-game!

📌 How to Play:
    🚗 Repair cars of different rarities in your workshop
    🏎️ Add repaired cars to your garage and drive them anywhere on the map
    👷‍♂️ Hire workers, unlock repair stations & lands to expand your workshop
    🌟 Collect and showcase rare cars in style

⭐ REMEMBER, your WORKERS keep WORKING and your LAND keeps BUILDING while you are OFFLINE!
